title: AirTrajectory coverage vectors mapped to Emilia-style hostile checks

target.purpose: review-only semantic mapping; not an Emilia conformance claim

checks.description: A valid subset of execution evidence must not prove completeness when one expected execution is absent.
Positive-only satisfied requirements must not prove claim completeness when an expected requirement has no explicit outcome.
An explicit negative requirement outcome remains covered and must not be collapsed into missing evidence.
emilia_alignment: keep verifier/evidence outcome separate from coverage
do not infer omission from an explicit negative result

non_claims: This file does not define an Emilia protocol extension.
This file does not claim Emilia adoption or endorsement.
This file does not claim cross-project conformance.
This file is a review artifact for hostile-vector semantic alignment.
